src: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 2025 vintage (GENZ2025; state legislative districts for the 2024 legislative session year), 1:500,000; State Senate districts from the Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line state legislative districts (the plan for the 2026 election cycle), clipped to the same shoreline
note: Michigan’s State Senate was redrawn: a new plan, approved in 2024, applies to the 2026 election and is the one drawn here. Each district is colored by who held that district number before the election, who was elected from the earlier lines. The State House map is unchanged.
